newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearbys up on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearbys up on mill buying.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures concluded a thinly traded session by settling mixed, with nearby months buoyed by mill buying, traders said.

"You have to assume it was mill buying," a trader said. "Otherwise, we had some commercial selling overhead. It was a light-volume day, lacking conviction ahead of the (USDA) stocks report on Monday."

Traders speculated that forecasts for dry weather next week caused KCBT May and July to lose some of the premium that had been built into them earlier this week, when it seemed farmers might face serious planting delays.
KCBT wheat closed one cent per bushel lower to four cents higher, with Dec up four cents at $4.42-1/4 a bushel.

Traders said Man International bought two million Dec bushels. Dreyfus' Term Commodities bear-spread one million March/Dec at 12-1/2 cents per bushel. Prudential bull-spread 500,000 Dec/March at 13 cents.
The KCBT estimated Friday's wheat futures volume at 24.340 million bushels, down from 30.515 million on Thursday.
